user.title: Mailbox
user.description:
Receipts are imported from PDF attachments of matching emails. The mailbox is only read; no email is marked as read, moved or deleted.

Gmail: use imap.gmail.com and an app password (Google account → Security → App passwords). Tip: create a Gmail filter that labels eBon emails, e.g. "REWE", and enter that label as folder.

data_description.password: For Gmail an app password, not your Google password.
data_description.folder: IMAP folder or Gmail label, e.g. INBOX or REWE.
data_description.sender: Only emails from this sender (or containing this text) are searched.
data_description.since: Older eBons are imported once from this date on.

reconfigure.title: Change mailbox
reconfigure.description: Leave the password empty to keep the current one. Changing the folder, sender or date searches the mailbox again (receipts already imported are skipped).

error.invalid_auth: Login failed. For Gmail use an app password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the IMAP server.
error.folder_not_found: Folder not found. For Gmail, enter the label name exactly as shown.

abort.already_configured: This mailbox folder is already set up.

user.title: Category
user.description: Products are assigned to this category by keywords in their receipt name, by the AI (Categorize products with AI) or manually (Set category). Keywords win over AI and built-in rules; a manual assignment always wins.

data_description.keywords: Comma separated, e.g. WINDEL, HIPP, BABY. Matched anywhere in the product name; umlauts may be written as on the receipt (UE) or as ü.
data_description.description: Optional: what belongs in this category, e.g. "baby food, diapers, care products for babies".
data_description.icon: Optional, e.g. mdi:baby-bottle. Shown on the category's sensor.
